title: Adaptive GR(1) Specification Repair for Liveness-Preserving Shielding in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2511.02605v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Shielding is widely used to enforce safety in reinforcement learning (RL), ensuring that an agent's actions remain compliant with formal specifications. Classical shielding approaches, however, are often static, in the sense that they assume fixed logical specifications and hand-crafted abstractions. While these static shields provide safety under nominal assumptions, they fail to adapt when environment assumptions are violated. In this paper, we develop an adaptive shielding framework based on based on Generalized Reactivity of rank 1 (GR(1)) specifications, a tractable and expressive fragment of Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) that captures both safety and liveness properties. Our method detects environment assumption violations at runtime and employs Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) to automatically repair GR(1) specifications online, in a systematic and interpretable way. translated_title: 自适应GR(1)规格修复用于强化学习中保持活性屏蔽
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.02605v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：屏蔽被广泛用于强化学习（RL）中强制执行安全性，确保智能体的行为始终符合形式化规格。然而，经典屏蔽方法通常是静态的，因为它们假设固定的逻辑规格和手工制作的抽象。虽然这些静态屏蔽在名义假设下提供了安全性，但当环境假设被违反时，它们无法适应。在本文中，我们开发了一个基于一阶广义反应性（GR(1)）规格的自适应屏蔽框架，这是线性时序逻辑（LTL）的一个可处理且富有表现力的片段，能够捕获安全性和活性属性。我们的方法在运行时检测环境假设违规，并采用归纳逻辑编程（ILP）在线自动修复GR(1)规格，以系统化和可解释的方式进行。这确保屏蔽优雅地演化，从而保证活性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于GR(1)规格的自适应屏蔽框架，通过运行时检测环境违规并利用归纳逻辑编程自动修复规格，确保强化学习中的活性保持。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive shielding framework based on GR(1) specifications that detects environment violations at runtime and uses inductive logic programming to automatically repair specifications, ensuring liveness preservation in reinforcement learning.
